title: The Jaeger article's comparison with Tempo points at the Tempo monolithic facts and states no unsourced contrast
goal: kb/public/logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline.md compares Jaeger all-in-one with Tempo monolithic by pointing at logs/loki-tempo-grafana-retention, where the Tempo monolithic facts are, and states no contrast its cited sources do not hold (no a binary for Windows against Tempo; the 0.0.0.0 note says only what the Jaeger docs say)

run:
import re, sys
lines = open("kb/public/logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
cmp_lines = [l for l in lines if "Tempo" in l and "Jaeger" in l and "distributor" in l]
points = bool(cmp_lines) and all("loki-tempo-grafana-retention" in l for l in cmp_lines)
unsourced = [l[:80] for l in cmp_lines if "a binary for Windows" in l]
stronger = [l[:80] for l in lines if re.search(r"0\.0\.0\.0`? is only", l)]
print("comparison lines:", len(cmp_lines), "| all point at loki-tempo-grafana-retention:", points, "| unsourced Windows-binary contrast:", unsourced or "none", "| 0.0.0.0 stronger than the Jaeger docs:", stronger or "none")
sys.exit(0 if points and not unsourced and not stronger else 1)
